note: Attacker-controlled file bytes (the compression-header block payload, all 0xFF) are read into the freshly malloc'd block buffer b->data of exactly uncomp_size bytes.

code: hdr->codecs[ds_id] = cram_decoder_init(hdr, encoding, cp, size, type, fd->version, &fd->vv);
note: The record-encoding-map entry (key BF, encoding E_VARINT_UNSIGNED=41) forwards the codec parameter pointer cp (the 0xFF bytes) and its size to the codec initialiser.
varint_get32 is called with a NULL end pointer, so the CRAM 4 varint reader performs an unbounded scan for a byte with the high bit clear instead of enforcing the end of the input buffer (data+size).
CRAM 4 varint wrapper forwards the NULL endp into var_get_u32, selecting the unsafe (unbounded) variant of the decode loop.

Unsafe decode loop keeps reading bytes past the end of the block buffer while the high bit is set; with an all-0xFF parameter region the read continues past b->data + uncomp_size into the ASAN redzone, an out-of-bounds read.
